description.value: Crust Bakery is an award-winning, female-owned Victoria institution serving French-inspired pastries, artisan breads, cakes, and savoury snacks made from scratch with seasonal local ingredients since 2013. This Uptown Mall location is one of two physical outposts alongside a Downtown Fort Street shop, and the bakery has even published its own cookbook. Trained baristas pour Caffe Umbria espresso daily, making it a reliable stop for cyclists wanting fresh baked goods and quality coffee.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Crust Bakery is an active, award-winning, female-owned French-inspired bakery with two Victoria locations; the OSM record corresponds to the Uptown Mall location. The website lists the Uptown address as 3535 Uptown Blvd (versus OSM's 3551) and supplies a phone number absent from OSM — both discrepancies are flagged. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 3551 Uptown Boulevard, but the bakery's own website lists the Uptown Mall location as 3535 Uptown Blvd, Victoria, BC V8Z 0B9.
Phone number (250) 978-2253 is absent from OSM but confirmed on the website.

Website homepage describes the bakery as being 'in the heart of Downtown Victoria,' which likely refers to the Fort Street location rather than this Uptown Mall location — minor branding inconsistency, not a concern about the record's validity.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established bakery with a confirmed website and two physical Victoria locations; a useful food and coffee stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The bakery operates two locations: Fort Street (730 Fort St, Victoria, BC V8W 1H2) and Uptown Mall (3535 Uptown Blvd, Victoria, BC V8Z 0B9). This OSM record corresponds to the Uptown Mall location. A separate OSM record may exist or be warranted for the Fort Street location.
